appName.message: Dual Subtitles — Lingogram: học ngoại ngữ trên YouTube và Netflix
appName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and the Web Store.

appDesc.message: Phụ đề song ngữ cùng lúc trên YouTube và Netflix. Học tiếng Anh qua video bạn vẫn xem, lưu từ mới chỉ với một chạm. Miễn phí.

ytOnboardingText.message: Chọn ngôn ngữ bạn đang học và tiếng mẹ đẻ của bạn để bắt đầu.
ytOnboardingText.description: Onboarding banner body asking the user to pick languages.

ytLearningLabel.description: Label for the "language I am learning" picker.

ytNativeLabel.description: Label for the "my native language" picker.

ytSelectPlaceholder.description: Placeholder option in a language dropdown.

ytSearchingTitle.description: Status banner heading while looking for subtitles.

ytSearchingText.message: Đang tìm phụ đề cho video này.
ytSearchingText.description: Status banner body while looking for subtitles.

ytNoSubsTitle.description: Status banner heading when a video has no subtitles.

ytNoSubsText.message: Video này không có phụ đề. Hãy thử video khác — không phải video nào trên YouTube cũng có phụ đề.
ytNoSubsText.description: Status banner body when a video has no subtitles.

ytSearchAgain.description: Retry button label on the no-subtitles banner.

ytReloadPage.description: Fallback button on the no-subtitles banner, shown after a retry still found no subtitles, that reloads the page.

ytNoSubsRetryText.message: Nếu video này có phụ đề nhưng chúng tôi không hiển thị chúng, hãy tải lại trang — cách này thường hiệu quả, và chúng tôi sẽ nhận được báo cáo để điều tra.
ytNoSubsRetryText.description: Status banner body after a failed retry. Qualifies the emergency reload click ('video HAS subtitles, extension failed') so it doubles as a bug report to the admins, and discloses that a report is sent.

ytSignInToSave.message: Đăng nhập để lưu từ vựng
ytSignInToSave.description: Account prompt to sign in and save vocabulary.

ytSavedBadge.description: Inline badge shown after a word is saved.

ytStyleSizeLabel.description: Label for the subtitle overlay font-size preset buttons.

ytStyleColorLabel.description: Label for the subtitle overlay text-color swatches.

ytStyleOffsetLabel.description: Label for the subtitle overlay vertical-position presets.

ytStyleBgLabel.description: Label for the subtitle overlay background-opacity presets.

ytGroupLanguages.description: Settings panel group header for subtitle track language pickers.

ytGroupReadingMode.description: Settings panel group header for reading-mode toggles.

ytModesLabel.description: Tiny uppercase label inside the sidebar quick-mode cluster (Dual/Guess/On-screen buttons). Keep it one short word.

ytGroupOverlay.description: Settings panel group header for on-video subtitle styling.

ytModeSwap.description: Button that swaps the learning and native subtitle tracks.

ytModeDual.description: Toggle that shows both languages at once.

ytModeGuess.description: Toggle for the word-guessing practice mode.

ytModeOnScreen.description: Toggle that shows subtitles on the video itself.

ytStyleEdgeLabel.description: Label for the subtitle text edge-style presets.

ytEdgeNone.description: Edge style preset: no text shadow or outline.

ytEdgeShadow.description: Edge style preset: drop shadow behind the text.

ytEdgeOutline.description: Edge style preset: dark outline around each letter.

ytStyleReset.description: Button that restores the default overlay appearance.

ytOverlayOffNote.message: Phụ đề trên video đang tắt
ytOverlayOffNote.description: Note shown in the style preview when the on-video overlay is disabled.

ytPreviewSampleMain.description: Sample subtitle line shown in the style preview when no video subtitle is loaded.

ytPreviewSampleSub.description: Sample translation line shown in the style preview.

ytSettingsTitle.description: Sidebar header title while the settings panel is open.

ytLangGroupAvailable.description: Dropdown group heading for subtitle languages the current video offers.

ytLangGroupOther.description: Dropdown group heading for languages not available in the current video (shown disabled).

ytRateButton.description: Primary button on the rating prompt; opens the extension's Web Store review page.

ytRateQ.description: Step 1 of the rating prompt: asks whether the user likes the extension before any store link is offered.

ytRateQSub.message: Bạn đã lưu được kha khá từ rồi đấy.
ytRateQSub.description: Subtitle under the step-1 question of the rating prompt; reminds the user of the value they got.

ytRateStep2.message: Đánh giá của bạn trên Web Store rất có ý nghĩa với chúng tôi. Người khác tìm thấy chúng tôi nhờ đó.
ytRateStep2.description: Body of step 2 of the rating prompt: a gratitude-framed ask for a Web Store rating, shown only after the user said yes.

ytRateYes.description: Positive answer on step 1 of the rating prompt; leads to the star step.

ytRateNo.description: Negative answer on step 1 of the rating prompt; thanks the user and closes.

ytRateThanks.message: Cảm ơn bạn đã cho chúng tôi biết.
ytRateThanks.description: Shown briefly after a negative answer on the rating prompt, then the card closes itself.

ytRateFeedbackTitle.description: Title of the feedback form shown after a negative answer on the rating prompt.

ytRateFeedbackHint.message: Chỗ nào chưa ổn? Bạn muốn đổi gì?

ytRateFeedbackSent.message: Cảm ơn bạn, điều này giúp ích thật sự.
ytRateFeedbackSent.description: Confirmation shown briefly after feedback is sent, then the card closes.

ytRateFeedbackFailed.description: Error shown when sending feedback failed; the user can retry.

ytRateSkip.description: Dismiss button on the feedback form shown after a negative answer.

ytRateSend.description: Submit button on the feedback form.

ytRateSending.description: Submit button label while the feedback is in flight.

ytRateThanksYes.description: Title of step 2 of the rating prompt, acknowledging the user's positive answer.

ytRateLater.description: Dismiss button on the rating prompt.

ytMenuLabel.description: Accessible name of the menu opened from the button in YouTube's player controls.

ytMenuModes.description: Player-menu row that opens the reading-mode submenu; shows the current mode next to it.

ytMenuModeSingle.description: Reading mode: one subtitle line, no translation. Menu wording of the neither-dual-nor-guess state.

ytMenuModeDual.description: Reading mode: original and translation at once. Menu wording of ytModeDual, which is icon-sized.

ytMenuModeGuess.description: Reading mode: some words hidden until clicked. Menu wording of ytModeGuess, which is icon-sized.

ytMenuBack.description: Player-menu control returning from a submenu to the main list.

ytMenuOpenPanel.description: Player-menu row that expands the sidebar.

ytMenuHidePanel.description: Player-menu row that collapses the sidebar; replaces ytMenuOpenPanel while it is open.

ytMenuSettings.description: Player-menu row that opens the sidebar with the settings panel showing.

ytMenuOverlay.description: Player-menu toggle for the on-video subtitle overlay.

ytMenuChooseLanguages.description: Player-menu button shown before any languages are picked; opens the sidebar onboarding.

ytMenuNoSubtitles.message: Video này không có phụ đề
ytMenuNoSubtitles.description: Player-menu status line when no caption track was found. The line doubles as a retry button.

ytMenuNoTranslation.message: Không có phụ đề tiếng của bạn, chỉ bản gốc
ytMenuNoTranslation.description: Player-menu status line when the video is captioned in the language being learned but not in the user's native language. Informational, not an error: this is a normal outcome and there is nothing to retry.

ytTogglePanel.message: Hiện hoặc ẩn bảng điều khiển
ytTogglePanel.description: Accessible name of the tab at the screen edge that opens and closes the sidebar.

ytAuthSignInTitle.description: Heading of the sign-in popup opened from the account row above the subtitle list.

ytAuthSignInAction.description: Button that opens the Lingogram website to sign in. 'lingogram' is the product name.

ytAuthSignOut.description: Button that signs the user out of their Lingogram account.

ytAuthSignedIn.description: Fallback account-row text when the user is signed in but the email is unknown.

ytAuthSignedInAs.description: Label above the signed-in user's email address in the account panel.

ytAuthOpenFailed.message: Không mở được trang đăng nhập. Hãy thử lại.
ytAuthOpenFailed.description: Error shown when the browser could not open the Lingogram sign-in tab.

ytQuickAddPill.description: Button that appears over a selected word to save it. 'Lingogram' is the product name; keep the leading plus sign.

ytQuickAddSaved.description: Confirmation after a word is saved. {term} is the word the user selected and must be kept.

ytQuickAddNeedsSignIn.message: Hãy đăng nhập ở hàng Lingogram phía trên danh sách phụ đề để lưu từ vựng.
ytQuickAddNeedsSignIn.description: Error shown when a word cannot be saved because the user is signed out.

ytQuickAddFailed.description: Error shown when saving a word failed. {error} is a technical message and must be kept.

ytPopupLoading.description: Placeholder while the toolbar popup fetches the account status.

ytPopupUnknownEmail.description: Shown in the popup when the signed-in account has no email address on record.

ytPopupSelect.description: Placeholder option in the language dropdowns before a language is chosen.

ytPopupLearning.description: Label for the dropdown where the user picks the language they are learning.

ytPopupNative.description: Label for the dropdown where the user picks their own native language.
